name: @activepieces/piece-provenexpert
description: Collect customer reviews, send survey invitations, and pull rating data from ProvenExpert.

auth.description:
Connect your ProvenExpert account to access reviews, surveys, and invitations.

**How to get your API credentials:**
1. Log in to your [ProvenExpert account](https://www.provenexpert.com/).
2. Go to **integrations ** from the left side panel.
3.  Copy your **Username** and **API Key**.
4. Paste them into the fields below.

get_rating_summary.name: get_rating_summary
get_rating_summary.description: Retrieves the overall rating value and total review count for your ProvenExpert profile.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the aggregate rating value and total review count for the authenticated ProvenExpert profile. Use to read a single profile-wide rating score, not individual reviews. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

create_survey_invitation_url.name: create_survey_invitation_url
create_survey_invitation_url.description: Generates a personalised, one-time-use survey link that you can send to a customer.

auth.description:
Connect your ProvenExpert account to access reviews, surveys, and invitations.

**How to get your API credentials:**
1. Log in to your [ProvenExpert account](https://www.provenexpert.com/).
2. Go to **integrations ** from the left side panel.
3.  Copy your **Username** and **API Key**.
4. Paste them into the fields below.

survey_code.description: Pick the survey to use. Surveys are created in your ProvenExpert account under the Surveys section.

email.description: Email address of the customer who will receive the survey link. The link is tied to this address.

name.description: Optional full name of the recipient. Used to personalise the survey experience.

aiMetadata.description: Generates a personalised, one-time-use survey invitation link for a specific survey and recipient email, returning the URL for you to deliver yourself (rather than having ProvenExpert email it). Requires a valid survey code and the recipient email the link is bound to. Not idempotent: each call mints a fresh invitation.

send_survey_invitation_email.name: send_survey_invitation_email
send_survey_invitation_email.description: Sends a survey invitation email through ProvenExpert to a single recipient. A 7-day reminder is sent automatically unless disabled.

auth.description:
Connect your ProvenExpert account to access reviews, surveys, and invitations.

**How to get your API credentials:**
1. Log in to your [ProvenExpert account](https://www.provenexpert.com/).
2. Go to **integrations ** from the left side panel.
3.  Copy your **Username** and **API Key**.
4. Paste them into the fields below.

survey_code.description: Pick the survey to use. Surveys are created in your ProvenExpert account under the Surveys section.

email.description: Email address that should receive the invitation.

name.description: Optional full name of the recipient — used to address them in the email.

subject.description: Optional custom subject line for the invitation. Leave empty to use the survey default.

salutation.description: Optional custom greeting line (e.g. "Hi Jane,"). Leave empty to use the survey default.

text.description: Optional custom message body. Leave empty to use the survey default body.

send_reminder.description: When enabled, ProvenExpert sends a reminder email after 7 days if the recipient has not responded.

aiMetadata.description: Sends a survey invitation email to one recipient via ProvenExpert, optionally with a custom subject, salutation, and body, and an optional automatic 7-day reminder. Choose this over Create Survey Invitation URL when ProvenExpert should deliver the email itself. Requires a valid survey code and recipient email. Not idempotent: each call dispatches a new email.

list_surveys.name: list_surveys
list_surveys.description: Returns all surveys on your ProvenExpert profile with their codes, names, and share links.

aiMetadata.description: Lists all surveys on the authenticated ProvenExpert profile, including each survey code, name, active state, and share links. Use to discover available surveys or to resolve a survey code needed by the invitation actions. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

get_profile.name: get_profile
get_profile.description: Retrieves the company and contact details of your ProvenExpert profile.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the company and contact details (company name, email, address, phone, website, public status) of the authenticated ProvenExpert profile. Use to read account/profile information rather than rating or survey data. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
